jobs.title: SAP SD IT Senior Consultant
jobs.description:
**The Impact You'll Make**
 Are you passionate about driving global digital transformation through SAP solutions? Danfoss is seeking a Lead SAP S/4HANA SD Solution Architect to support and enhance our SAP ecosystem across on\-premise and cloud ERP platforms.
   

  

 This role is responsible for designing, implementing, and optimizing SAP S/4HANA solutions with a focus on Sales and Distribution, Order\-to\-Cash, Logistics Execution, Billing, Transportation Management, and system integrations. The successful candidate will partner with business stakeholders and technical teams to deliver scalable SAP solutions, drive continuous improvement initiatives, and support business growth through innovative ERP capabilities. Success in this role requires deep SAP expertise, strong business process knowledge, and the ability to manage complex integrations and change initiatives within a global environment.
   

  

**What You’ll Be Doing**
 Responsibilities for this position include, but are not limited to, the following:
   

  

* Design and implement SAP S/4HANA solutions across Sales and Distribution, Order\-to\-Cash, Pricing, Logistics Execution, Transportation Management, Billing, and Master Data processes.
* Conduct business process analysis including current\-state assessments, future\-state design, gap analysis, business blueprint development, and solution recommendations aligned with SAP best practices.
* Lead configuration, testing, deployment, and support activities for SAP ERP solutions, including RICEF development coordination, defect resolution, and change request management.
* Manage integrations between SAP and external platforms including Descartes Transportation Management System (TMS), Edicom e\-Invoicing, CRM systems, Electronic Data Interchange (EDI), and warehouse solutions.
* Create functional specifications, provide technical guidance, develop test scenarios and test data, and support unit, integration, and user acceptance testing activities.
* Drive continuous improvement initiatives through incident management, root cause analysis, solution optimization, and collaboration with technical, integration, and testing teams.
* Support SAP S/4HANA Cloud administration activities including onboarding, offboarding, solution scope activation, KPI development, custom in\-app extensions, and system governance.
* Partner with business stakeholders to ensure successful delivery of SAP\-related projects, enhancements, and strategic digital transformation initiatives.


**Required Qualifications**
**What We're Looking For**
* Bachelor's degree in Information Technology, Management Information Systems, Computer Engineering, Computer Science, Mechanical Engineering, Industrial Engineering, Electrical Engineering, or a related field.
* Minimum 10 years of SAP consulting experience with strong expertise in Sales and Distribution and Order\-to\-Cash processes.
* Minimum 10 years of experience with delivery processing including batch determination, inbound and outbound deliveries, stock transfers, order processing, and proof of delivery.
* Minimum 10 years of experience with route determination, IDOCs, output determination, and SAP integration processes.
* Minimum 7 years of experience supporting shipping and logistics business processes.
* Minimum 5 years of experience serving as a functional lead, solution architect, or SAP consultant on ERP implementation projects.
* Minimum 2 years of experience with SAP S/4HANA Cloud solutions and integrations involving e\-Invoicing, warehouse interfaces, and Transportation Management Systems.


**Preferred Qualifications**
* Experience supporting global SAP S/4HANA transformation programs.
* Experience integrating SAP with Descartes TMS, Edicom e\-Invoicing, CRM platforms, and EDI solutions.
* Strong understanding of warehouse management and extended warehouse management integrations.
* Experience leading large\-scale ERP implementation, upgrade, and optimization projects.
* SAP certifications in SAP S/4HANA Sales, Sourcing and Procurement, SAP Hybris Billing, SAP S/4HANA Cloud, Manufacturing, Professional Services, Cloud Onboarding, or SAP Activate methodologies.


 Job Criteria
   

  

* Strong analytical and problem\-solving capabilities.
* Excellent communication and stakeholder management skills.
* Ability to translate complex business requirements into scalable SAP solutions.
* Strong project leadership and change management experience.
* Ability to manage multiple priorities in a fast\-paced global environment.
* Strong understanding of end\-to\-end business processes and cross\-functional SAP integrations.
* Demonstrated commitment to continuous improvement, operational excellence, and customer\-focused solution delivery.


**What You'll Get From Us**
 At Danfoss, we believe that a diverse and inclusive workplace fosters creativity, innovation, and a broader perspective in decision\-making. When you consider this job posting, do you feel like your profile is not a perfect match? Numerous studies have found that women and people of color are more likely to apply only when they meet all requirements listed in the job posting. Even if you do not check all the boxes, we encourage you to apply anyway. We are curious to find out how you can bring new insights to the role or to Danfoss as an organization.
   

  

 We are excited to offer you the following benefits with your employment:
   

  

 Bonus system
   

  

 Paid vacation
   

  

 Retirement plan
   

  

 Flexible working hours
   

  

 Personal insurance
   

  

 Opportunity to join Employee Resource Groups
   

  

 State of the art virtual work environment
   

  

 Employee Referral Program
   

  

**Ready to Make a Difference?**
 If this role excites you, we’d love to hear from you! Apply now to start the conversation and learn more about where your career can go with us.
   

  

**Our Commitment to Transparency**
 Salary ranges listed reflect only primary location and currency.

jobs.description:
SAP IS\-U Billing Functional Lead Consultant
 



 Job Location: Remote
 



 Duration: 12\+ Months Contract with Possible extension
 



 Visa: GC or USC
 



  





**Job Summary** 




  





 We are seeking an experienced SAP IS\-U Billing Functional Consultant with strong hands\-on expertise in SAP Industry Solutions for Utilities, specifically IS\-U Billing. The ideal consultant will have a solid understanding of end\-to\-end utility billing processes and the ability to work closely with business stakeholders, functional teams, and technical teams to analyze requirements, configure solutions, troubleshoot issues, and support project delivery.
 



  





 The consultant should have recent, hands\-on experience working with SAP IS\-U Billing and be comfortable operating independently in a client\-facing environment. Experience supporting complex utility billing processes, integrations, testing, and production issues is highly valued.
 



  





**Key Responsibilities** 



* Lead and support SAP IS\-U Billing functional activities throughout the project lifecycle.
* Analyze business requirements and translate them into effective SAP IS\-U Billing solutions.
* Perform functional configuration and customization within the SAP IS\-U Billing module.
* Work with business stakeholders to understand utility billing requirements, business processes, and pain points.
* Design and document end\-to\-end billing processes and functional solutions.
* Configure and support billing\-related master data, billing parameters, rates, and billing processes.
* Analyze and resolve billing errors, exceptions, and production issues.
* Investigate complex billing scenarios and determine root causes across functional processes and integrations.
* Work closely with technical teams on functional specifications, enhancements, interfaces, reports, and custom developments.
* Review technical solutions to ensure they align with SAP IS\-U Billing business requirements.
* Participate in requirements gathering, process design, configuration, testing, deployment, and post\-production support.
* Develop functional specifications and detailed business/process documentation as required.
* Support SIT, UAT, regression testing, and defect resolution.
* Prepare and execute functional test scenarios covering various utility billing scenarios.
* Collaborate with integration teams to validate data flow between IS\-U Billing and related SAP/non\-SAP systems.
* Support data validation, reconciliation, and issue resolution during testing and implementation.
* Participate in cutover, go\-live, hypercare, and production support activities.
* Provide functional guidance and knowledge transfer to other team members.
* Identify opportunities to improve billing processes, controls, and operational efficiency.
* Communicate effectively with technical teams, business users, project managers, and other functional teams.

And we’re counting on your unique voice and perspective to help EY become even better, too. Join us and build an exceptional experience for yourself, and a better working world for all.
   

  

**Career Family: SAP Utilities**
**Role Type: Functional Consultant**
**The opportunity**
 As part of our EY GDS\-Utilities team, you will work to implement and support SAP IS\-U projects for clients. You will get an opportunity to work with high quality team. You will get an opportunity to build innovating product which solves client’s problems.
   

  

 We’re looking for Senior resources with expertise in
 **SAP FI\-CA** 
 to join the EYD GDS team. This is a fantastic opportunity to be part of a leading firm whilst being instrumental in the growth.
   

  

**Your Key Responsibilities**
* To provide functional knowledge with hands\-on experience in electricity, gas and water utilities.
* Hands on experience configuring the IS\-U system
* Drive Business Workshops, Blueprint Sessions, develop BBPs/BBDs FS, Test Scenarios, conduct Trainings, perform Testing and provide defect management support for Device Management module
* Design core / customized business processes and provide best practices for ISU.
* Communicate complex requirements to and from Technical and Non\-technical stakeholders
* Willing to travel as per requirement
* Monitors the progress and the quality of the project


**Skills And Attributes For Success**
* Should understand different business processes in the Utility Industry (Regulated and Deregulated)
* Should possess SAP FICA knowledge for preparation of business blueprints, business process plan (BPP), functional documents, and test cases etc.
* Should have knowledge of the Meter to Cash
* Should have experience in FICA Dunning procedure/Collection Strategy, payment (cash desk/external cash desk) integration with payment channels, write off, return processing, security deposit, installment plan, and promise to pay.
* Exposure of Country specific localization.
* Experience in BRIM CI FICA is good to have.
* Experience in configuring FICA Events and BRF\+ (functional).
* Strong knowledge of clearing strategy, clearing rules.
* Experience in Cash Desk and clarifications.
* Strong knowledge of month\-end and period\-end closing and FICA to FICO GL integration.
* Experience in the de\-regulated/Regulated energy market.
* Develop templates and methods to improve the efficiency of application support.
* Gather and prioritize relevant SAP Business requirements and designing the appropriate solution
* Understands configuration dependencies and inter\-relationships between other modules of SAP such as Device Management, CS/CRM, Billing and design and troubleshoot in the area with this knowledge
* Define test scenarios to cover full scope of the business as well as creating master data and carry out the unit, cycle and integration tests
* Should be well versed to make enhancements in specific FICA events.
* Must have completed multiple SAP projects and have excellent communication skills
* Confidence working within an offshore/onshore delivery model
* Proven expedience large stream of work across multiple locations
* Consulting experience advantageous
* Strong hands\-on experience on FI\-CA concepts:
+ Company Code Setup
+ Chart of Accounts and GL setup
+ Main / Sub Transaction Setup
+ Security Deposit Process
+ Incoming Payments (Real Time, Direct Debit, Cash Desk, etc.)
+ Outgoing Payments and Returns
+ Collection process using Collection Strategy
+ Collection Agency related process
+ Transfer Posting process
+ Escheatment process

* Strong knowledge of month\-end and period\-end closing and FICA to FICO GL integration.
* Implementation experience of BRF Plus.
* Experience and knowledge of using middleware technology to integrate SAP with third party systems for payments, collection agencies, etc.
* Experience in data migration.
* Can work under minimum supervision, good time management and work planning


**To qualify for the role, you must have**
* College degree in related technology field (Computer, Engineering, Science, etc.) or comparable job experiences
* Approximately 5 to 8 years of experience in a functional role. Able to exhibit a progression of increasingly complex job responsibilities during the period
* Prior SAP BRIM CI role is a must
* Should have worked on minimum 1 implementation from scratch as a lead consultant.


**Ideally, you’ll also have**
* Experience on integration with third\-party applications
* Knowledge of integration with SAP RAR, BRIM CI/SOM/CM
* Hands on experience in SAP S4 HANA Platform
* Experience on tools like JIRA or equivalent tool to maintain stories.
* SAP Utilities certifications are a plus:
+ Certification in SAP FICA (IUT240 / AC240 / BR240\)
+ Certifications in SAP BRIM Convergent Invoicing (AC245 / BR245\)


**Technologies and Tools**
* SAP FI\-CA / FI\-CAX
* SAP FIORI
* Jira or similar tools
* Azure DevOps or similar tools


**What We Look For**
* A Team of people with commercial acumen, technical experience, and enthusiasm to learn new things in this fast\-moving environment
* An opportunity to be a part of market\-leading, multi\-disciplinary team in the integrated global transaction business worldwide.
* Opportunities to work with EY Utilities practices globally with leading businesses across a range of geographies


**What We Offer**
 EY Global Delivery Services (GDS) is a dynamic and truly global delivery network. We work across six locations – Argentina, China, India, the Philippines, Poland and the UK – and with teams from all EY service lines, geographies and sectors, playing a vital role in the delivery of the EY growth strategy. From accountants to coders to advisory consultants, we offer a wide variety of fulfilling career opportunities that span all business

jobs.title: Senior SAP Specialist - Payroll Solution Architecture
jobs.description:
**Are you excited about the opportunity to design technical solution in a team within an industry leader in Energy Technology?**

 **Partner with the best**

  

As a Payroll Solution Architect, you will be responsible for:

  

* Designing, developing, and customizing functionalities within SAP HCM modules, including Payroll, Personnel Administration, Time Management, Travel Management, Interfaces, and Organizational Management.
* Serving as the functional liaison between Operations, Business Process Leads, and the Applications Team, translating business needs into functional specifications.
* Leading or contributing to the execution of both large and small HR projects, including compliance with legal and HR\-related requirements.
* Defining and Executing development in SAP HR/HCM using technologies such as ABAP, Web Dynpro, Floor Plan Manager, Web Services, SAP Fiori, and UI5\.
* Analyzing, troubleshooting, and optimizing existing programs and implement necessary enhancements.
* Managing day\-to\-day operational activities in SAP ECC for HR.
* Automating routine tasks by developing scripts and templates to streamline support and management operations.
* Continuously assessing and improving systems and processes based on user feedback and incident analysis.
* Creating and maintaining technical documentation, including user manuals, training materials, and implementation guides.

 **Fuel your passion**

  

To be successful in this role, you will:

* Minimum of 7 years of SAP HCM/HR configuration experience in Payroll, Employee data management, Organization Management, Tax and HR operations
* Experience in posting payroll to finance in SAP ECC and S/4
* Demonstrated understanding of US \& Canada Payroll Processing Methodology.
* Experience in payroll schemas and Rules, Wage Types, Overpayment Functionality
* Knowledge of BSI tax factory configuration and maintenance.
* Knowledge of FICA limits, Tax Reporter, SAP Note/BSI TUB updates and Year End activities.
* Experience with Tax update bulletin application and testing.
* Experience with Garnishment configuration, benefits configuration and integration with payroll.
* Knowledge in direct deposit and check configurations
* Experience with integrating and interfacing third\-party vendors with SAP.
* Experience with testing activities – Test scenario creation, defect triaging, support test execution.
* Bachelor’s degree in information technology or related technical field.

  

Desired Characteristics:

  

* Exposure to SuccessFactors and Human Experience Management.
* Experience with modern SAP technologies (Fiori, UI5\)
* Solid verbal and written communication skills.
* Ability to work effectively in multicultural and cross\-functional teams.
* Analytical and problem\-solving mindset.
* High level of initiative, curiosity, and willingness to learn new technologies.
* Proactive in staying up to date with SAP and industry trends.
* Strong interpersonal skills with demonstrated leadership qualities.
* Self\-motivated and able to manage priorities in a dynamic environment.
* Experience in global ERP rollouts.
* Ability to identify and mitigate technical risks, with a solution\-oriented approach.
* Capable of managing multiple priorities independently in a fast\-paced setting.

 **Work in a way that works for you**


We recognize that everyone is different and that the way in which people want to work and deliver at their best is different for everyone too. In this role, we can offer the following flexible working patterns (where applicable):

  

* Permissive Leave \- Leave can be taken as needed for vacation, illness, or personal reasons, but must be coordinated with and approved by your manager.
* Flextime \- Shift or change of hours worked over the course of a working day while still working a standard\-length workday/workweek.
* Remote Work \- Regular responsibilities performed away from the designated business location for a portion or entirety of the arranged work hours.
* Compressed Work Week \- Reduces the number of days worked over a week while still adhering to the standard hours for the full week.

 **Working with us**


Our people are at the heart of what we do at Baker Hughes. We know we are better when all our people are developed, engaged, and able to bring their whole authentic selves to work. We invest in the health and well\-being of our workforce, train and reward talent, and develop leaders at all levels to bring out the best in each other.

 **Working for you**


Our inventions have revolutionized energy for over a century. But to keep going forward tomorrow, we know we must push the boundaries today. We prioritize rewarding those who embrace challenge with a package that reflects how much we value their input. Join us, and you can expect:

  

* Contemporary work\-life balance policies and wellbeing activities.
* Comprehensive private medical care options.
* Safety net of life insurance and disability programs.
* Tailored financial programs.
* Additional elected or voluntary benefits.


You will be eligible to participate in Company\-sponsored benefit programs, including health \& welfare programs and the Thrift Plan (401k). You will have a choice of coverage options that best suit your needs. Coverage options and contribution amounts are related to your benefit elections, base salary level, and specific requirements of each of these plans.


This position is eligible for our comprehensive and competitive benefits package, which can be found ***here***, and is further eligible for additional forms of compensation such as bonuses subject to the terms of the applicable benefit plans or policies.

We are an energy technology company that provides solutions to energy and industrial customers worldwide. Built on a century of experience and conducting business in over 120 countries, our innovative t
